excluded_cases.exclusion_reason: frozen excluded-enrollment control; no observer call

policy.definition: Schematic stored-raster apertures; all enrolled group members. Clear: minimum detail >=0.30; smooth: minimum detail in [0.05,0.30). Both need >=96px, range>=0.10 and code-tail fractions<0.20. Engineering demonstration selected using three source-only development probes, not human recommendations.
policy.category_source: source-pixel predicates over all declared group apertures, before predictions
policy.group_rule: one stratum per declared dependent acquisition group

measurement_policy.definition: Schematic stored-raster apertures; all enrolled group members. Clear: minimum detail >=0.30; smooth: minimum detail in [0.05,0.30). Both need >=96px, range>=0.10 and code-tail fractions<0.20. Engineering demonstration selected using three source-only development probes, not human recommendations.
measurement_policy.routing: one simultaneous match; zero or multiple matches withhold deployment
measurement_policy.aperture: explicit integer xyxy half-open source rectangle; omission means full stored raster
measurement_policy.enrollment: all declared group members, including prospectively excluded observation cases
